integrity: The infinite inequalities and equality cases are proved symbolically. Exact finite Reid--Tai and ratio computations are supplied only as regression checks and are not used as a substitute for the proof.
limitations: The theorem is restricted to characteristic zero and the two-heavy family of weighted projective spaces. The Chern numbers are those of the associated smooth weighted projective stack; no claim is made about every singular-coarse-space Chern theory.
title: Sharp normalized second-Chern range for canonical two-heavy weighted projective stacks
